text:
maria: heads-up — the new 2.3.0-int8 build passed unit smoke. Want to run a short live canary with slo-aware gating today.
aj: +1. What metrics are we gating on? latency/quality/cost?
maria: primary: p95 latency (<=180ms), hallucination rate delta (<=+0.5%), semantic similarity (embedding cosine >= 0.94 vs prod), token cost delta (<+8%).
liam: can we make the gating dynamic by weight of traffic? i.e., stricter at 5% than 20%.
sophia: yes — propose sliding thresholds: at <=5% require 0.2% hallucination delta, p95<=150ms; at 20% allow 0.5% hall delta, p95<=180ms. Also use rollback if any smoke tests show deterministic regressions.
maria: implemented a monitoring rule in console, added signals: halluc_count/total, embed_sim_median, p95_lat, token_cost_avg. I'll start 2% traffic in 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary model=redwood-2.3.0-int8 id=canary-1742008888 at=1742008888
aj: quick ask — what's the eval set? Is it cross-product of T0 prompts + internal regression set?
maria: using eval-suite v12 (prod-like logs + regen prompts). Also a small 500-case manual set for hallucination triage.
liam: after 30m, if embed_sim_median drops >0.03 vs baseline, auto scale back to shadow and alert.
sophia: adding a "mergepoint" rule: if p95 spikes by >25% but quality holds, we throttle traffic not rollback fully. Rule looks like: ```if p95_ratio>1.25 and hall_delta<=0.2% => throttle_to(traffic*0.5)```
maria: logs so far: p95=142ms (good), embed_sim_median=0.945 (baseline 0.947), halluc_delta=+0.18%, token_cost=+6.5%.
aj: looks safe at 2%. Keep an eye on edge-case prompt failures.
liam: can we send a tiny sample of mismatches to #model-oncall? I'll wire a webhook.
maria: I uploaded 24 mismatch cases to the alert — flagging for review.
sophia: if halluc_delta crosses 0.5% or any deterministic F1 drop on regen tests, auto-rollback.
aj: ack. thanks.
deploy-bot: canary health check: passed 10/10 smoke tests, traffic=2%, duration=28m
maria: planning to ramp to 10% in 30m unless we see drift. ping @ops for approval.
ops-bot: approved ramp to 10% per SOP-rl-3. Manual override required to stop.
liam: noted — will watch embedding drift dashboard.
